_comment: PROVENANCE HONESTY NOTE: this artifact is a transcription of a summary the operator posted directly into this Claude Code conversation, describing what they personally verified against the official KLPGA entry-list page (https://klpga.co.kr/web/tourInfo/entry?gameCode=2026090003) using real network access outside this session. This session's own network access to klpga.co.kr remains proxy-blocked (confirmed repeatedly). The raw HTML bytes of that page have NOT been transported into this session and have NOT been machine-parsed here -- per the operator's own explicit instruction, this file does not reconstruct or guess at that HTML from the summary below. It records ONLY the field/category counts and the 6 named special-category players the operator explicitly listed. The remaining 114 qualified ('자격자') players were reported as present on the official page but were NOT individually named in what was posted -- they are NOT enumerated here, and no placeholder/guessed names are used in their place. This artifact is not a valid input to klpga.parsers.entry_list_parser and must never be run through it or treated as an entry_snapshot substitute -- see klpga.tournament_entry_bootstrap.collect_entry_list_snapshot_from_offline_html for the real import path, which still requires the actual page HTML (or a complete, row-by-row transcription of all 120 entries) to produce a valid entry_snapshot.
captured_by: operator, via real network access outside this session
not_captured: the individual names/player_ids of the 114 '자격자' (qualified) entries -- confirmed present on the official page by the operator, but not transcribed into this conversation and therefore not recorded here. A valid entry_snapshot for this game_code cannot be produced until either the raw page HTML or a complete 120-row transcription is provided.
